when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'DROP DATABASE' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'DROP TABLE' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'DROP SCHEMA' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'drop database' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'drop table' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'DELETE FROM' and command not_contains 'WHERE' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'delete from' and command not_contains 'where' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'UPDATE' and command not_contains 'WHERE' and command contains 'SET' then ask 'UPDATE without WHERE clause modifies ALL rows'
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'TRUNCATE' then ask 'TRUNCATE permanently deletes all rows from the table'
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'ALTER TABLE' and command contains 'DROP COLUMN' then ask 'Dropping a column permanently destroys data'
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'GRANT ALL' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'SUPERUSER' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'FLUSHALL' then ask 'FLUSHALL deletes all data from all Redis databases'
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'FLUSHDB' then ask 'FLUSHDB deletes all data from the current Redis database'
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'dropDatabase' then ask 'dropDatabase permanently destroys a MongoDB database'
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'volumeDelete' then block
